extracted.name: Sinigang na Baka
extracted.description: A simple Filipino beef and vegetable soup in a sour tamarind base that we eat over rice! A meal in itself!
ingredient_lines: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes
0.5 pound fresh green beans, rinsed and trimmed
0.5 medium head bok choy, cut into 1 1/2 inch strips
1 head fresh broccoli, cut into bite size pieces
instruction_lines: Heat oil in medium stock pot. Saute onion and garlic until tender. Add beef to pot, and saute until browned. Pour in water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.
Place tomatoes and green beans in pot, and continue to simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in bok choy, broccoli and tamarind soup mix. Simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
